description.value: Roots Rising Bakery is a 100% gluten-free bakehouse on the North Island Highway in Courtenay, founded by a chef whose personal health journey led her to specialize in food as medicine. The bakery produces artisan breads, pastries, and cakes across three distinct lines — Rising Roots, Primal Roots (keto/paleo/diabetic-friendly), and Wild Roots (vegan sourdough) — making it a rare stop catering to cyclists with celiac disease, dairy intolerances, and other dietary restrictions. Products are also stocked at a number of local Courtenay-area cafes and restaurants.

address.value: 5225 North Island Highway, Courtenay, BC V9J 1S7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Roots Rising Bakery is an active gluten-free bakehouse at 5225 Nth Island HWY, Courtenay, BC V9J 1S7, with phone 250 650 7314 matching the OSM record. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website, so those remain null. A notable discrepancy exists between OSM hours (Mo, Fr-Su 08:00-18:00) and the website (Thu-Sat 9AM-6PM, closed Sun-Wed), suggesting the OSM hours are outdated.
concerns: Hours discrepancy: OSM tags list Mo, Fr-Su 08:00-18:00 but the website shows Thu-Sat 9AM-6PM with Sunday through Wednesday closed — OSM hours appear outdated and should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active specialty bakery on a main cycling corridor offering artisan breads and baked goods with broad dietary accommodation; a practical and distinctive food stop for touring cyclists.
